Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Subject: Non-Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (NCAM C) of CCTV Surveillance System at India Government Mint, Hydera bad for a period of 12 Months. Scope of Non-Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC): 1. The AMC shall include Preventive Maintenance (PM), Predictive Maintenance, and Breakdown Maintenanc e (BM). 2. The Non comprehensive AMC scope shall cover all components including but not limited to: i. 94 Nos. CCTV Cameras comprising Bullet, Dome, PTZ and other installed camera typ es. ii. 01 No. Central Switch. iii. 24 Nos. Distribution Switches. iv. Existing 64-Channel and 32-Channel NVRs with associated HDDs. v. L2/L3/PoE switches and associated CCTV network infrastructure. vi. Associated cables, connectors, junction boxes, power/network connectivity and other existing accessories forming part of the CCTV system. 3. Replace all life expired components and defective parts during maintenance and repairs, Spares and con sumables if required are in the scope of IGMH. 4. Maintenance Responsibilities: i. The contractor shall perform daily system monitoring and upkeep through deputed dedicative in house technician for 6 days a week (26 days/month), 09:00 AM to 05:30 PM. ii. Preventive maintenance shall be carried out weekly basis through deputed dedicativ e in house technician. iii. Breakdown maintenance shall be carried out immediately upon complaint through d eputed dedicative in house technician. iv. IGMH shall provide all spares, consumables and equipment if required. Technician To ols will be in the scope of Vendor v. The system downtime shall be kept to minimum practicable levels. vi. Splicing, Cable Jointing & Termination Works: a. The contractor shall carry out all types of splicing, cable jointing, cable termination, re-ter mination, crimping, connector replacement, continuity testing and associated restoration works required for maintaining the existing CCTV Surveillance System, entirely at its own c ost and without any additional charges to IGMH. b. The scope shall include, but shall not be limited to, network/LAN cable jointing, CAT6 cabl e termination and re-termination, fibre-optic cable splicing wherever applicable, replaceme

nt of connectors/couplers, patching and restoration of damaged cable sections, testing of c ontinuity and network connectivity, and making the system fully operational after completi on of such work. c. The contractor shall arrange all skilled manpower, tools, testing instruments, jointing/ter mination accessories and minor materials/consumables required for carrying out such wor ks. No separate claim shall be admissible towards labour, service charges, transportation, tools, testing or routine jointing/termination accessories. d. Any splicing, jointing or termination work necessitated due to routine maintenance, break down rectification, shifting/repositioning of cameras, fault diagnosis or restoration of CCTV connectivity shall be deemed to be included in the quoted NCAMC rates. e. In case any major cable, equipment or component is required to be replaced due to failure/damage, the major replacement material shall be provided by IGMH, wherever spec ifically covered under the Scope of IGMH, while installation, splicing/jointing, termination, t esting and commissioning of the replacement material shall remain in the contractor's sco pe without any additional service/labour charges. vii. All services shall comply with prevailing Indian Govt/PSU CCTV standards. viii. The bidder shall ensure continuous and reliable operation of the system. 5. Manpower Deployment: i. The contractor shall deploy minimum one (01) qualified CCTV Technician at site. ii. The technician shall be Minimum Diploma in Electronics/Electrical/Telecommunication/IT/C omputer discipline with Minimum 02 years of relevant experience in CCTV/IP surveillance syste m installation, maintenance and troubleshooting. [Contractor shall ensure Minimum wages co mpliance applicable to Skilled Technicians as per notified rates of Govt of India or Government of Telangana] iii. It is the Contractor responsibility to Submit Valid Police verification certificate (PVC), exper ience Certificate and All educational Qualification certificates for verification before deputation of technician. iv. The technician shall be available 6 days a week (26 days/month), 09:00 AM to 05:30 PM. v. Attend breakdown complaints immediately, including Sundays/holidays whenever require d for critical security-related failures, without additional charges. vi. Responsibilities include cameras network integration, fault detection, repair, logging, coord ination with OEM, and reporting. vii. In case of absence of the deployed technician, the contractor shall provide a suitably qualif ied replacement without interruption of service. Absence of the nominated technician shall not relieve the contractor of its contractual responsibilities. viii. Deployed technician must be physically fit and comfortable to work at heights, including us e of ladders and elevated platforms. ix. Given the nature of the work, which involves height-based access and precision adjustmen ts, it is essential that the selected resource is both technically competent and safety-conscious . x. Contractor trained technician, stationed at site shall attend to the break down calls proble ms immediately and perform checks, connection checks and integrated unit working check, et c. And carryout the following tasks: a. Integration of New IP CCTV Cameras to the NVR system if required and installation of same in place of defective cameras. b. Locating of the defective unit. c. Detection of the defective modules and accessories. d. In case of failure, repair will be carried out at module level. e. Maintain the record of all service activities. f. Maintaining daily checklist of working status of cameras and ensuring all cameras wor k without fail. g. Cleaning of equipment i.e, Cameras, Switches etc., h. Diagnosis and rectification of faulty CCTV cameras & Switches. i. Checking and re-termination of network cables (CAT6 where applicable) j. Power supply verification & rectification for surveillance equipment k. Alignment, repositioning, and reinstallation of cameras includes drilling and camera in stallation l. Checking and diagnosis of the faults as mentioned in the complaint register or being i nformed otherwise and replacement of defective items/component.

m. Check working of all the cameras and their display at the control Room. n. Checking the backup status of all CCTV Cameras and maintaining checklist. o. The technician shall conduct CCTV system performance checks at intervals not excee ding two hours during working hours, or as directed by IGMH, and record the status in the prescribed register/checklist. p. Checking operation of all switches, junction boxes, cables, visual display & visual chec k of control panels. Rectify the fault if any exists. q. Inspect entire system for proper functioning, any unusual conditions and to take nece ssary action if required. r. Tightening of connections 6. The Successful Bidder shall be fully responsible for overall system performance, uptime, and health durin g the AMC period. 7. General Terms and Conditions: i. The contractor shall make all reasonable efforts to maintain maximum possible operation al availability of the CCTV surveillance system. Repeated failure of the same equipment shall b e analysed and reported with corrective recommendations. ii. The contractor shall maintain complete documentation, wage registers, logs, and service r ecords. iii. Contractor shall pay PF and ESI (Group accidental insurance if ESI not applicable). Along w ith monthly bills, Vendor has to provide PF Challan and Electronic Challan- cum-Return (ECR) w ith deputed technician details & also ESI Challan and CR [ If not applicable submit Group accid ent insurance copy] iv. PROVISION OF RETURNABLE TOOLS/ACCESSORIES/EQUIPMENT: Contractor shall arrange to provide basic CCTV Technician tools and testing equipment to the deputed technician such as: · Combination Plier : 01 No · Wire Stripper / Cutter: 01 No · Insulated Screwdriver Set (Flat & Phillips): 01 Set · Neon Tester : : 01 No · Adjustable Spanner (Wrench): : 01 No · Electric Drill Machine + Masonry Drill Bits : 01 No · Digital Multimeter : 01 No · Network Tester: 01 No · Fiber Tester: 01 No · Insulation Tapes, LAN Connectors, Cable ties and Cleaning cloth: as required. · It is Contractor responsibility to Safe keep the tools with deputed technician and may withdraw supplied tools from Technician once contract is expires. v. Contractor shall ensure Minimum wages compliance applicable to Skilled Technicians as p er notified rates of Govt of India or Government of Telangana vi. Scope of IGMH / Responsibilities of IGMH: The following shall be in the scope and responsib ility of India Government Mint, Hyderabad (IGMH): a. Provision of Spares: IGMH shall arrange/provide major replacement spares, equipment an d components required for restoration of the existing CCTV system. The requirement shall be identified and recommended by the contractor and shall be subject to approval and ava ilability with IGMH. b. Consumables: Major consumables/materials required for replacement or repair, such as C CTV cameras, NVRs, HDDs, switches, PoE equipment, SMPS/power supplies, major network cables and other capital/replacement items, shall be provided by IGMH c. Ladder/Access Support: Where required for working at height, IGMH may provide availabl

e ladders/elevated access arrangements and necessary support manpower for safe handlin g of ladders/platforms, as specifically approved by IGMH. However, the contractor shall re main responsible for safe execution of the maintenance work by its personnel. d. Coordination with New CCTV Project: IGMH shall coordinate with the agency executing the new CCTV project and provide necessary directions/permissions for interface, migration, te sting, commissioning and eventual transition from the existing CCTV system to the new sy stem. vii. Any failure affecting security shall be treated as critical and attended on priority. viii. Support manpower if required for the deputed technician to work at heights and for Ladder handling will be arranged by IGMH ix. The contractor and its personnel shall maintain strict confidentiality regarding CCTV camer a locations, network architecture, IP addresses, passwords, recording arrangements, security a rrangements and any information accessed during execution of the contract. x. No CCTV footage, photograph, video, system configuration, password, network informatio n or other security-related information shall be copied, removed, transmitted, disclosed or sha red with any third party without prior written authorization of IGMH. xi. Any unauthorized access, copying, disclosure or misuse of CCTV/security information shall be treated as a serious contractual and security violation and may result in termination/debar ment and other action as applicable. xii. The contractor shall not change any system password, IP configuration, network configura tion, NVR configuration or camera configuration without prior authorization of IGMH. xiii. The contractor shall not install unauthorized software, devices, storage media or network e quipment on the CCTV network. xiv. Disposal of Replaced Items: All replaced defective/obsolete equipment, components and m aterials shall remain the property of IGMH. The contractor shall hand over such items to the de signated IGMH representative and shall not remove them from the premises without written p ermission. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses For MSE/Start-up firm: The bidder must have capability to provide the relevant services. i.e. NCAMC of CCT V surveillance systems. Bidders are requested to submit the documentary proofs like past Purchase orders against their capability in providing similar services. ii. For other firm - Experience and past performance: The bidder should have experience of having success fully completed relevant services, in any one of the last five years ending on ’31.03.2026’ iii. The bidder should submit duly stamped & signed copy of bid document as a token of acceptance of all t he terms & conditions of the tender. . 10. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) 1. Nature and Duration of Contract: The contract shall be for a period of 12 months from the date of comme ncement of services or as specified in the GeM Contract. However, the contract is being proposed as an int erim maintenance arrangement pending commissioning of the new CCTV Surveillance System. The contrac t shall therefore be subject to the Special Foreclosure Clause given in terms and conditions of contract. Th e contract period of 12 months shall not constitute a guarantee for utilisation of services for the entire 12- month period. IGMH shall have the right to reduce/foreclose the services based on commissioning of the n ew CCTV system or change in operational requirement. The bidder shall quote the rates keeping this condi tion in view.

2. Special Foreclosure Clause – Commissioning of New CCTV System: IGMH reserves the absolute right to fo reclose/terminate the NCAMC contract, either wholly or partially, at any time upon successful installation, c ommissioning, testing and issuance of Final Acceptance Certificate (FAC) of the new CCTV Surveillance Sys tem, or when the existing CCTV system/any portion thereof is no longer required. Such foreclosure shall no t entitle the contractor to claim compensation, loss of profit, damages, idle manpower charges or any othe r compensation for the unexpired/unutilised period of the contract. Payment shall be made only for service s satisfactorily rendered up to the effective date of foreclosure, subject to applicable deductions, penalties and contractual conditions. The bidder shall be deemed to have accepted this condition by submitting the bid. 3. Payment Terms: i. Payment towards NCAMC charges shall be made on a Monthly basis, subject to the satisfa ctory completion of services during the respective month. ii. The vendor shall be required to maintain and submit the following documents along with t he monthly bill: a. Daily CCTV Status reports and Maintenance records duly signed by the concerned authori ty of the Department b. Breakdown maintenance service reports [ if available during respective month] c. Monthly payment transaction proofs of salary credits to deputed service technician. d. Wages register with deputed technician details e. PF Challan and Electronic Challan- cum-Return (ECR) with deputed technician details f. ESI Challan and ECR with deputed technician details [ If ESI not applicable submit the vali d Group accident insurance copy] g. Certified Attendance Sheet iii. Full monthly payment as per issued contract shall be released only upon satisfactory pres cribed attendance of the CCTV technician deputed at site. Hence it is contractor responsibility to replace technician with other suitable technician during absence of stationed technician. iv. The payment shall be released proportionately based on actual attendance of deputed tec hnician, with full payment will be released only when the technician has attended duty for 8 ho urs * 26 days or more in a month and has worked between 09:00 AM to 05:30 PM every man-d ay. Payment shall be release in accordance with the actual attendance hours of technician rec orded against 480 Minutes in every man-day. No extra payment shall be release if technician worked more than 8 hours in particular day due to exigency of maintenance requirement.
